title: Technician I Propagation Batch Record
description: A traceable propagation record for donor acceptance, sanitation, tray identity, rooting progress, count reconciliation, quarantine, and handoff.
instructions: Verify donor and work-order identity before preparing labels or material.
Record sanitation and isolation checkpoints as they occur.
Preserve donor-to-tray genealogy and never guess an ambiguous identity.
Reconcile started, rooted, lost, rejected, and handed-off counts before closing the batch.
limitations: This record does not replace facility donor-acceptance, clean-stock, or quarantine procedures.
The template does not authorize protocol redesign or release of suspect material.
